description: Deterministic entry, one private structured review20 model step, pure reconcile30/validate40 and byte-preserving finalize50. Drafts and validation context stay private; finalize50 confirms an authoritative permit and conditionally publishes the exact in-memory snapshot.

invocation.ui: The same structured object, with expectedRevisionId supplied by the UI.
invocation.project: Required from the selected host project (mls.actualProject), never inferred from stored modules.
invocation.invalidInput: A status-only task with root LLM skipped; no source or candidate write.

reads: real platform catalogs, pipeline, ontology plan and module registry captured once for later validation
writes: private task long memory only: frozen validation context, its hash and correctionAttemptsUsed
executableSteps.goal: Freeze the explicit project, module, base, change, revision and request after validating both folder references and all source hashes.

writes: private task result only (maximum 280000 serialized characters, including the sealed base and snapshot hashes required by reconcile30)
executableSteps.goal: Produce and deterministically validate either policy-qualified scalar replacements or a clarification without writing L4 storage.

reads: validated review20 private result containing sealed base, proposal, snapshot hashes, validation context hash and correction state
writes: private task result only (maximum 400000 serialized characters)
executableSteps.goal: Run only mechanically demonstrable dependency gates, preserve the proposal byte-for-byte and return ready, clarification or unsupported without any transformation.

reads: frozen validation context and correctionAttemptsUsed from task long memory
writes: private validation result only (maximum 550000 serialized characters)
finalize50 step only when every affected gate is checked
executableSteps.goal: Validate the reconciled draft with the real context frozen at entry, preserve the draft and correction counter, and classify ready, clarification, unsupported or invalid without correction or publication.

reads: fresh authoritative candidate pointer/snapshot when replay misses
executableSteps.goal: Rehash frozen bytes, rebuild the deterministic exact snapshot, replay a durable submitted attempt first, or else mark the complete output snapshot and conditionally publish it.

reservedNotScheduled.reason: No safe directed correction rule or correction LLM step is integrated; validation never increments correctionAttemptsUsed.
Publication is complete, but no button, shared CLI or implementation run is connected by this private agent.

safety: entry10 and reconcile30 make no LLM call; review20 makes exactly one structured call and has no automatic retry.
No candidate write, original write, materializer or planner dispatch occurs; a validated proposal is kept only in bounded private task step state.
reconcile30 recomputes review diffs, accepts no mutation and turns clarification/unsupported into private terminal state rather than inventing dependencies.
validate40 rechecks identity, revision, hashes, context hash and affected areas; it neither rereads stor/tobe nor consumes a correction attempt.

finalize50 reads the immutable revision namespace rather than tobe/plan, preserves unchanged source bytes, refuses drift, replays only the exact durable submitted identity before pointer gating, and never serializes CandidateSnapshot bytes into task results.
A missing or stale active revision is a refusal, not an implicit snapshot rewrite.
This flow does not report an accepted review or completed release.
